function.name: wildlife_population_assess_growth

We need to respond with calls to those functions. Provide JSON arguments accordingly. Use correct names. For first: species="deer", location="Washington State" (maybe "华盛顿州"), duration=10. Second: species="deer", ecosystem="forest", location="Washington State", timeframe maybe 10 or default 5 but they ask about last decade so use 10.
